name: Blackwood Lake
summary: In southern Eastern Plaguelands, a small Argent Dawn camp watches Blackwood Lake. Its waters teem with hostile, corrupted elementals and hold memories of tragedy and war.

sections.title: A Polluted Memory
sections.body: The plague that poisons much of the Eastweald has reached Blackwood Lake. Diseased water elementals churn beneath its murky surface and attack anyone who comes near the shore.

sections.title: Relics of the Fallen
sections.body:
Blackwood Lake holds grim relics from the Battle of Darrowshire. The Extended Annals of Darrowshire record that the severed skull of Horgus the Ravager was cast into its rancid depths.

Nearby, an Argent Dawn medic tends battered infantry at a small forward outpost. The medic struggles to keep soldiers alive amid the Scourge's devastation.

faq.q: What creatures lurk in Blackwood Lake?
faq.answer: Corrupted water elementals infest Blackwood Lake. Necromantic runoff and filth have twisted the Plaguelands' freshwater spirits into violent, toxic beings.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn stationed at the lake?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps a small field camp near Blackwood Lake. There, an Argent Medic cares for wounded infantry and supports patrols fighting along the roads between Darrowshire and nearby Scourge strongholds.

faq.q: What Darrowshire relic is buried in Blackwood Lake?
faq.answer: The skull of Horgus the Ravager lies in Blackwood Lake, according to the Annals of Darrowshire. Horgus was one of the primary Scourge leaders in the assault on Darrowshire. He was brought down, and his skull was hurled into the lake's depths.

angles.text: For humans of Lordaeron, Blackwood Lake recalls how thoroughly the Scourge poisoned the kingdom's rural heartland.
As a paladin, you see how the blight corrupts Lordaeron's natural elementals in Blackwood Lake's polluted waters and decaying surroundings. They need the purifying touch of the Light.
